newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - D.Jones in talks on new store sites.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - D.Jones in talks on new store sites.

text.p: Department store chain David Jones Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks about developing new stores, in addition to the three it plans to open over the next three years.

"We are in very active negotiations on a number of sites. I can't add much more to that, except to say that we are anxious to get into Western Australia and build more in Victoria," chief executive Chris Tideman told reporters.
David Jones does not have any stores in Western Australia.
Tideman said the group had also looked at possible expansion into New Zealand, but there were no firm plans at this stage.
